page.overview:
What is Uxie?

Uxie is a greyish-blue, fairy-like Pokémon. Uxie has two long, leaf-like tails each encrusted with a red gem. It has a yellow face and its eyes are closed. Uxie's eyes are closed because it is said to wipe the memories of all who gaze upon it. Uxie has a yellow brain-like helmet with another red gem onto its forehead.

Along with Mesprit and Azelf, Uxie will help guide the player through the Distortion World to capture Giratina. After this is done, the player can head back to Lake Acuity and capture Uxie, without necessarily having to win the Sinnoh League.

The player, with Cogita's guidance and accompanied by Volo and either Adaman or Irida (depending on the player's choice), has to journey to the three lakes of Hisui to get the necessary materials to forge the Red Chain in order to stop "the Pokémon on the other side of the Rift".

Uxie's test: " Come. I will test your knowledge. Combee. Zubat. Unown. Magneton. Dusclops. How many are their eyes? Tell me each, one by one yet all at once. Answer me." (Spoiler : it's 60131) Once the player tells the right answer, the Lake Guardian will give Uxie's Claw. Once all the "pieces of the spirit" are gathered, Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf will appear at the Shrouded Ruins and forge the Red Chain.
